description: Read a bounded UTF-8 part of any turn's complete stored prompt, including refused turns. Continue at nextOffset; totalBytes and sha256 identify the full prompt. Requires an existing daemon.
name: claudexor_thread_prompt

outputSchema.description: One bounded part of a single validated run event, read from the run's own event log by run id and seq. Concatenate parts in offset order until nextOffset equals totalBytes; only then is the event consumed.

nextOffset.description: Where the next part starts; equal to totalBytes when this part ends the event.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset where this part starts.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of all totalBytes; verify the reassembled text before parsing it.

text.description: Bytes [offset, nextOffset) decoded as UTF-8; a boundary never splits a character.
